title: Smatchet perf baseline (one scenario × one host)
description: Captured by `scripts/dev/perf-run.sh` + checked-in via `scripts/dev/perf-baseline.sh init|bump`. One file per (scenario, host) pair at `docs/perf/baselines/<scenarioId>.<host>.json`. Compared against fresh runs by `scripts/dev/perf-compare.py` per `docs/perf/regression-policy.json`. See `docs/plans/shipped/pillar-1-2-perf-review-system.md` § C1 + § D1 for full design.

scenarioId.description: Matches the scenario name registered via ScenarioRunner::RegisterFactory (see Source/Core/src/Commands/BuiltinCommands.cpp). Example: 'idle', 'priority-grid-scroll'.

captureCommit.description: 40-char git SHA the baseline was captured against. Required so a future run can recompute the same input.

captureDate.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the capture.

captureHost.description: Host tag the baseline applies to. One of 'dev' (developer machine, advisory) or 'ci-windows-latest' (GitHub Actions runner, gating). Per § D1 baselines are NOT shared across hosts.

captureRunnerOs.description: Smatchet target OS string. Currently always 'windows-msys2-ucrt64'. Reserved for future Linux/Mac if cross-OS perf comparisons get prioritised (out of scope today).

target.description: Aggregate frame-time targets for THIS scenario. Pillar 1 floor (6.94 ms mean) + 100 Hz floor (10.0 ms p99) apply by default unless overridden here.

rows.description: Per-scope perf-monitor rows captured at scenario end (mirrors the perf.snapshot JSON shape from BuiltinCommands_Perf.cpp).

hardwareNote.description: Free-form note about the capture hardware (CPU, GPU, RAM). Useful when comparing dev baselines across team members.

perScenarioPolicyOverride.description: Optional override of the default thresholds from regression-policy.json. Same shape as `default` there.
